references.observed: Elongate green body with pink scale edges and maze-like facial pigment, low long dorsal/anal, pink-orange pectorals with blue margins and a yellow-centred emarginate tail.

limitations: Original Thalassoma lunare visual study based on the inspected Dave Harasti photograph. The supplied generic Wrasse name is retained; colour phases vary and fine dentition/ray counts are simplified. Swimming is artist-tuned.
